result.summary: This PR enables the `BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING` preprocessor definition in two CI jobs (`i686_no_ipc` and `native_previous_releases`) that already test with `BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE`. It leaves the MSAN fuzzing job untouched and adds an inline comment documenting that enabling invariant checks there would exceed the CI runner's 240-minute execution limit.
result.problem: CI jobs currently run with Boost.MultiIndex safe mode enabled but without invariant checking, missing internal container validity checks on operations in debug builds.
evidence: PR description quotes Boost.MultiIndex documentation noting invariant checking adds runtime validation of data structure invariants.
PR description and commit message note that the MSAN fuzz CI job is deliberately excluded because invariant checks push it beyond the 240-minute runner limit.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes to the diff; rebased on updated master.
result.card: This PR enables Boost.MultiIndex invariant checking in two existing CI debug jobs that already test safe mode. The check catches potential multi-index container corruption or invariant violations during functional tests in CI. The MSAN fuzzing job is intentionally left without the flag to avoid exceeding runner timeouts.

risk.why: It only modifies compiler flags and comments in CI environment setup scripts.
